posts.cooked:
Removing Cantarell fonts from Store cause removing GNOME Shell in Fedora 43.
I testing in Boxes. I test Fedora 42 and Cantarell font protected you can’t remove it.
In Fedora 43 you can remove it without warning and it cause remove GUI Apps and GNOME Shell.

posts.name: Joe Walker
posts.cooked:
Looks to be an upstream packagekit bug. DNF backend doesn’t have the same protections from removing itself as Yum · Issue #197 · PackageKit/PackageKit · GitHub

You can reproduce using pkcon remove abattis-cantarell-fonts
be sure and say NO to the transaction

Edit:
After testing on F42 and and confirming this works, this is definitely broken on F43. 2400573 – Protected packages can be removed via packagekit in Fedora 43

I’m not sure the referenced packagekit bug applies.
Thanks for pointing this out!
